projects.title: SilentGuard
description: Browser guardrail engine that runs a NER model on consumer CPUs in under 300ms, across 10+ file types and org policies with 50+ rules.
projects.problemStatement: Sensitive data pasted into AI tools leaves the organization's control. Keeping inspection on the device removes that exposure.

projects.title: Labridge
description: In-house LIS that connects to vendor LIS and analyzers over sockets in real time, validates HL7 data, and fans out clean results to internal services.
projects.problemStatement: Paying for a vendor LIS adds recurring lab cost. Analyzers speak HL7 with slightly different grammars, and results must still arrive complete and accurate in real time.

projects.title: Livprint
description: React Native (Expo) mobile app for a startup's MVP, with a self-hosted Payload CMS and Supabase backend on a private VPS during development.
projects.problemStatement: Managed hosting such as Render or cloud services adds recurring cost early on, before the product has revenue. Self-hosting during development keeps that spend low.

projects.title: Astmio
description: Async Python library for the ASTM E1394/E1381 clinical lab protocol, a ground-up rewrite of python-astm with plugins, TLS, and Prometheus metrics.
projects.problemStatement: Clinical instruments speak the ASTM E1394/E1381 protocol, but the existing python-astm library is synchronous and hard to extend. Labs need a reliable, observable way to connect devices to their systems.
highlights: protocol Engine for high throughput environment

projects.title: LinnkedOut
description: AI-powered YouTube curation engine that replaces short-form feeds with high-signal educational videos, using semantic embeddings and a multi-factor quality score.
projects.problemStatement: Short-form video feeds are built for engagement, not learning, and clickbait makes it hard to find useful content. Users need a way to discover deep, relevant videos based on what they already want to learn.

writings.title: From Black Box to Production: Building a Custom LIS in Three Months
writings.description: How a single LIS developer intern reverse-engineered a hematology analyzer's proprietary protocol and built a configurable, HIPAA-aware LIS that parses HL7 and ASTM data with 100% accuracy in real time.
